title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs With Spicy Corn
description: Juicy marinated chicken thighs roasted with sweet corn and spicy jalapeños for an easy, flavorful sheet-pan meal.

steps.instruction: In a bowl, mix mayonnaise, basil, garlic, and 2 tablespoons jalapeño brine. Add chicken and coat well.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes (up to 6 hours).
In a bowl, toss corn, pickled jalapeños, olive oil, remaining salt, and half the scallions.
Arrange chicken on a baking sheet and roast for 12 minutes.
Add corn mixture to the pan and drizzle everything lightly with oil.
Continue roasting for 10–15 minutes, stirring corn once, until chicken is cooked through.
Turn broiler on high and broil for 2–4 minutes until lightly charred.
Garnish with basil, remaining scallions, fresh jalapeño slices, and a squeeze of lime juice. Serve hot or at room temperature.
